title: Three Winters and One Short Collar
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：jacket　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jacket 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the tailor ① made the jacket that no client in the shop would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the Monday. The ② jacket, meaning the coat itself and not the collar, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a jacket, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ jacket in that shop had the same short collar beside it, and the ④ jacket at the far hook, meaning the button they kept for the children to sew and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A jacket, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tailor said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jacket was the whole of the matter, meaning the cover and not the coat. The ⑥ jacket, meaning the cover and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jacket, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a coat and a cover. He said the cover is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ jacket had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short collar. The ⑧ jacket of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three Mondays of recording; jacket, he said, is either the button at the far hook or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jacket I remember is the coat recorded in the card, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ jacket, my mother said in 1983, is the only coat that improves by being recorded; every jacket, she said, is a cover that has agreed to look like a coat. She said the cover was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 夹克；短上衣（指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 夹克；短上衣（指那件上衣本身，与衣领相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the jacket 缝制这件夹克
D. n. 夹克；短上衣（指留给孩子们缝的那一颗那一件）
E. n. 裁制之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的夹克之事）
F. n. 夹克；短上衣（指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一件）
G. n. 遮蔽、保暖（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 保暖（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the jacket that no client in the shop would have recorded
The jacket, meaning the coat itself and not the collar
the jacket at the far hook

answers.why: make the jacket 意为“缝制这件夹克”，1974 年那位裁缝把铺子里没有一位客人肯记录的一件夹克做了一遍。
jacket 意为“夹克；短上衣”，指那件上衣本身而不是衣领，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
jacket 意为“夹克；短上衣”，指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一道短短的衣领。
jacket 意为“夹克；短上衣”，指最远那只挂钩留给孩子们缝的那一颗那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jacket 意为“遮蔽、保暖”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份遮蔽就是那件事的全部。
jacket 意为“保暖”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件上衣，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jacket 意为“夹克；短上衣”，指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一件，到 1979 年这一件成了卡片里的一行。
jacket 意为“裁制之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的夹克之事是一处铺子和三个星期一的记录。
jacket 意为“夹克；短上衣”，我记得的是卡片里记录过的那一件，1981 年交货了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一件。
jacket 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，夹克是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的上衣。
